title: Saltwater cowboy charterz
specs: Captain Anthony is a U.S. Coast Guard veteran and South Florida native with lifelong fishing skills and knowledge of Key Largo waters
gap: Prices for 4, 6, and 8 hour fishing trips not stated
blurb: Guests fish inshore or offshore waters around Key Largo aboard a 25' Skeeter bay boat. Captain Anthony, a South Florida native and U.S. Coast Guard veteran, guides the fishing expeditions. Trips are available for 4, 6, or 8 hours and include opportunities to catch various local fish species.
highlights: Captain Anthony is a U.S. Coast Guard veteran and South Florida native with lifelong fishing skills and knowledge of Key Largo waters

quotes.text: Anthony is an experienced captain and made us feel very safe on the water. We enjoyed fishing with him. He is very patient and knowledgeable about the fish and the area in which he charters. Big plus is his past service to America as a Coast Guard Veteran. If you want any type of fishing adventure either day or night call Anthony and he will make every moment count. Exhilarating for my teenage son and his friend!! Will use him again to fish!

Capt. Anthony was awesome!!! I took my 3 cousins (ages 12-13) out and Anthony helped them, was very patient and taught them a lot about fishing, boats and navigating. He cut-up the fish we caught and recommended a local restaurant for fish tacos. I highly recommend him. Kids had a blast!!!! Much appreciated Anthony.

Have a great fishing with Capt Anthony. He knows the water and is very professional. I get bigs Snaper,grouppers,yellow tails and some others. Was a great experience we booked him for a second round fishing. Highly recommend him . Thanks Capt Anthony for a beautiful day that we enjoyed with my family. Thx IV

Me and a few buddies went out with Captain Anthony and had a blast! Caught tons of fish due to Captain Anthony’s knowledge about where to fish and what to fish for! If you are in the keys definitely book a trip with Saltwater Cowboy Charterz, you won’t be disappointed

Booked a charter with capt Anthony and was one of the best decision I’ve made this year. Wanted to go snapper fishing and he put me on some big ones. He’s very knowledgeable of local waters and experienced fisherman. He will put you on the fish.!!!

What a great day Anthony! non stop catching. Captain Anthony knew the waters and right where to go to catch fish. great boat, excellent guide. Hope you have a great year captain and we will see you next year!
